race.comment: ITS A SPONGE DARL (6) put together some minor placings then was at his best last start to score by 1.1 metres over 1660m at Albion Park on November 19. His last-start form is good enough to win a race of this calibre. LAST CALL (2) disappointed last time when eighth over 2040m at this track. Draws well so can turn things around. CARLY PEREZ (8) is in the mix following a respectable second at her most recent appearance over 1660m at Albion Park. LITTLE SURFER GIRL (7) has been quite consistent of late and can feature with even luck.
